NiFe_catalytic_related_fold.scope: Accession-pinned reference identity plus shared catalytic-related fold. NiFe/complexI and Hmd/Hmd-like domains alone do not prove H2 catalysis; unresolved kind is never promoted.

FeFe_catalytic_related_fold.scope: Accession-pinned reference identity plus shared catalytic-related fold. NiFe/complexI and Hmd/Hmd-like domains alone do not prove H2 catalysis; unresolved kind is never promoted.

Fe_catalytic_related_fold.scope: Accession-pinned reference identity plus shared catalytic-related fold. NiFe/complexI and Hmd/Hmd-like domains alone do not prove H2 catalysis; unresolved kind is never promoted.

NuoCD_fused.scope: Respiratory complexI C/D fold; noncatalytic reference, not a hydrogenase or a positive training identity.

NuoD_Mbx_related.scope: ComplexI-related D fold; source role retained as decoy, not catalytic evidence.

Hmd_paralog.scope: Hmd/Hmd-like shared fold only; inactive-family reference status is not a per-protein biochemical measurement.

NiFe_small_NuoB_related.scope: Shared electron-transfer small-subunit/NuoB fold; cluster count/type is independently evaluated, not inherited from domain name.

FeS_relay.scope: Generic electron-transfer fold only; does not identify a unique physical partner, cluster occupancy or bifurcation mechanism.

NuoE_Fer2.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

HytD_Fer2.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

NuoF_flavin_FeS.scope: Flavin/nucleotide/FeS module; NADH versus NADPH and bifurcation cannot be resolved from these shared domains.

SHI_gamma_NAD_FAD.scope: SHI gamma FAD/NAD-binding module, not HydG maturase; exact structure supports the reference. No automatic query cofactor occupancy inference.

FrhB.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

MvhD.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

HdrA.scope: HdrA flavin/FeS architecture plus exact reviewed protein correspondence; short profile evidence is not a complete-domain claim.

HdrB.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

bacterial_cytochrome_b.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

HybB_NrfD.scope: NrfD-like membrane subunit. A probable cytochrome description in a source is not experimental heme evidence; do not infer heme or occupancy.

cytochrome_c3.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

antiporter_large.scope: Shared antiporter-like membrane fold; repeated domain intervals remain separate. Does not prove ion pumping, stoichiometry or a mechanism.

NuoH_related.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

NuoC_related.scope: NuoC-related fold only; an NuoC fusion in a catalytic protein cannot replace evidence for its catalytic core.

MrpE.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

MrpF.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

MrpG.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

MbhD.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

MnhB.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

NuoK_related.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

MbhE.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

MbhI_structure_only.scope: No informative Pfam model in this collection. Exact experimentally resolved complex chain supports the reference role; no vacuous-domain acceptance.

HucM_plugin.scope: Helical membrane plugin; deposited HucM is only20-79 of189 residues. Primary co-purification/mass-spectrometry and gene-deletion evidence supports oligomer assembly, not catalytic necessity or a full resolved domain.

VhtC_cytochrome_inference.scope: No informative Pfam match. Curated cytochrome homologs and native vht operon support the inferred membrane-cytochrome component; VhtC does not co-purify in the referenced study. Not direct purified-subunit reaction proof.

Fdh_molybdo.scope: Shared molybdo/tungstoenzyme architecture; metal identity and substrate specificity need the reference context, not just domain matching.

CODH.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy

NifH_context.scope: Nitrogenase context, never an enzyme member or direct proof of hydrogenase physiology.

NifDK_context.scope: Nitrogenase context, never an enzyme member or direct proof of hydrogenase physiology.

HupT_kinase.scope: Kinase architecture supported by the R.capsulatus H217 autophosphorylation study. HupT-named PF11939 assembly proteins are not this role.

HupR_regulator.scope: Family/fold evidence only; not query activity, donor specificity or cofactor occupancy
